verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ አመከሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይቤ
                  ፡ ነየ ፡ አነ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things that God tempted Abraam, and said to him, Abraam, Abraam; and he said, Lo! I am here.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after these things that God tempted Abraam, and said to him, Abraam, Abraam; and he said, Lo! I am here.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
translations.ron: După acestea, Dumnezeu a încercat pe Avraam şi i-a zis: "Avraame, Avraame!" Iar el a răspuns: "Iată-mă!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ὁ Θεὸς ἐπείρασε τὸν Ἁβραὰμ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, Ἁβραὰμ, Ἁβραάμ· καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ንሥኦ ፡ ለወልድከ ፡ ዘታፈቀር ፡ ይስሐቅሃ ፡ ወሑር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ላዕላይ ፡ ወአዕርጎ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወሡዖ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ዘእቤለከ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Take thy son, the beloved one, whom thou hast loved—Isaac, and go into the high land, and offer him there for a whole-burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

translations.lxx: And he said, Take thy son, the beloved one, whom thou hast loved—Isaac, and go into the high land, and offer him there for a whole-burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
translations.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
translations.ron: Şi Dumnezeu i-a zis: "Ia pe fiul tău, pe Isaac, pe singurul tău fiu, pe care-l iubeşti, şi du-te în pământul Moria şi adu-l acolo ardere de tot pe un munte, pe care ţi-l voi arăta Eu!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, λάβε τὸν υἱόν σου τὸν ἀγαπητὸν, ὃν ἠγάπησας, τὸν Ἰσαὰκ, καὶ πορεύθητι εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ὑψηλὴν, καὶ ἀνένεγκε αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν ἐφʼ ἓν τῶν ὀρέων ὧν ἄν σοι εἴπω.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወረሐነ ፡ አድጎ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ ደቆ ፡ ወይስሐቅሃኒ ፡ ወልዶ ፡ ወሠጸረ ፡
                  ዕፀወ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ በጊዜሃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  በሣልስት ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And Abraam rose up in the morning and saddled his ass, and he took with him two servants, and Isaac his son, and having split wood for a whole-burnt-offering, he arose and departed, and came to the place of which God spoke to him,

translations.lxx: And Abraam rose up in the morning and saddled his ass, and he took with him two servants, and Isaac his son, and having split wood for a whole-burnt-offering, he arose and departed, and came to the place of which God spoke to him,
translations.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
translations.ron: Sculându-se deci Avraam dis-de-dimineaţă, a pus samarul pe asinul său şi a luat cu sine două slugi şi pe Isaac, fiul său; şi tăind lemne pentru jertfă, s-a ridicat şi a plecat la locul despre care-i grăise Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ἀναστὰς δὲ Ἁβραὰμ τὸ πρωῒ, ἐπέσαξε τὴν ὄνον αὐτοῦ· παρέλαβε δὲ μεθʼ ἑαυτοῦ δύο παῖδας, καὶ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ· καὶ σχίσας ξύλα εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν, ἀναστὰς ἐπορεύθη, καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον, ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεὸς, τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ለደቅ ፡ ንበሩ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አድግ ፡ ወአነ ፡ ወወልድየ ፡ ንሑር ፡ እስከ ፡ ዝየ ፡
                  ወሰጊደነ ፡ ንገብእ ፡ ኀቤክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam said to his servants, Sit ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will proceed thus far, and having worshipped we will return to you.

translations.lxx: And Abraam said to his servants, Sit ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will proceed thus far, and having worshipped we will return to you.
translations.kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Avraam slugilor sale: "Rămâneţi aici cu asinul, iar eu şi copilul ne ducem până acolo şi, închinându-ne, ne vom întoarce la voi".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἁβραὰμ τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ, καθίσατε αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῆς ὄνου· ἐγὼ δὲ καὶ τὸ παιδάριον διελευσόμεθα ἕως ὧδε· καὶ προσκυνήσαντες ἀναστρέψομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ወአጾሮ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ እሳተኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡
                  ወመጥባሕተኒ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam took the wood of the whole-burnt-offering, and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took into his hands both the fire and the knife, and the two went together.

translations.lxx: And Abraam took the wood of the whole-burnt-offering, and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took into his hands both the fire and the knife, and the two went together.
translations.kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
translations.ron: Luând deci Avraam lemnele cele pentru jertfă, le-a pus pe umerii lui Isaac, fiul său; iar el a luat în mâini focul şi cuţitul şi s-au dus amândoi împreună.
translations.grk: Ἔλαβε δὲ Ἁβραὰμ τὰ ξύλα τῆς ὁλοκαρπώσεως, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν Ἰσαὰκ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ· ἔλαβε δὲ μετὰ χεῖρας καὶ τὸ πῦρ καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν, καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ δύο ἅμα.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ [ለአብርሃም ፡ አቡሁ ፡] አባ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ምንት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ዕፅ ፡
                  ወእሳትኒ ፡ አይቴ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ በግዑ ፡ ለመሥዋዕቱ ።
verses.translation: And Isaac said to Abraam his father, Father. And he said, What is it, son? And he said, Behold the fire and the wood, where is the sheep for a whole-burnt-offering?

translations.lxx: And Isaac said to Abraam his father, Father. And he said, What is it, son? And he said, Behold the fire and the wood, where is the sheep for a whole-burnt-offering?
translations.kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
translations.ron: Atunci a grăit Isaac lui Avraam, tatăl său, şi a zis: "Tată!" Iar acesta a răspuns: "Ce este, fiul meu?" Zis-a Isaac: "Iată, foc şi lemne avem; dar unde este oaia pentru jertfă?"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰσαὰκ πρὸς Ἁβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ, πάτερ· ὁ δὲ εἶπε, τί ἐστι, τέκνον; εἶπε, δὲ, ἰδοὺ τὸ πῦρ καὶ τὰ ξύλα, ποῦ ἐστὶ τὸ πρόβατον τὸ εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሬኢ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በግዖ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam said, God will provide himself a sheep for a whole-burnt-offering, my son. And both having gone together,

translations.lxx: And Abraam said, God will provide himself a sheep for a whole-burnt-offering, my son. And both having gone together,
translations.kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
translations.ron: Avraam însă a răspuns: "Fiul meu, va îngriji Dumnezeu de oaia jertfei Sale!" Şi s-au dus mai departe amândoi împreună.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἁβραὰμ, ὁ Θεὸς ὄψεται ἑαυτῷ πρόβατον εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν, τέκνον. πορευθέντες δὲ ἀμφότεροι ἅμα,

verses.geez:
ወበጽሑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ዘይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወነደቀ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ በህየ ፡ ወወደየ ፡
                  ዕፀኒ ፡ ወአዕቀጾ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወአስከቦ ፡ በከብዱ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ዕፀው ።
verses.translation: came to the place which God spoke of to him; and there Abraam built the altar, and laid the wood on it, and having bound the feet of Isaac his son together, he laid him on the altar upon the wood.

translations.lxx: came to the place which God spoke of to him; and there Abraam built the altar, and laid the wood on it, and having bound the feet of Isaac his son together, he laid him on the altar upon the wood.
translations.kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
translations.ron: Iar dacă au ajuns la locul, de care-i grăise Dumnezeu, a ridicat Avraam acolo jertfelnic, a aşezat lemnele pe el şi, legând pe Isaac, fiul său, l-a pus pe jertfelnic, deasupra lemnelor.
translations.grk: ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον, ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεός· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ Ἁβραὰμ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἐπέθηκε τὰ ξύλα· καὶ συμποδίσας Ἰσαὰκ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, ἐπέθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐπάνω τῶν ξύλων.

verses.geez: ወአልዐለ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንሣእ ፡ መጥባሕተ ፡ ወይሕርዶ ፡ ለወልዱ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay his son.

translations.lxx: And Abraam stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay his son.
translations.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
translations.ron: Apoi şi-a întins Avraam mâna şi a luat cuţitul, ca să junghie pe fiul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Ἁβραὰμ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ λαβεῖν τὴν μάχαιραν, σφάξαι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ነየ ፡ አነ ።
verses.translation: And an angel of the Lord called him out of heaven, and said, Abraam, Abraam. And he said, Behold, I am here.

translations.lxx: And an angel of the Lord called him out of heaven, and said, Abraam, Abraam. And he said, Behold, I am here.
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
translations.ron: Atunci îngerul Domnului a strigat către el din cer şi a zis: "Avraame, Avraame!" Răspuns-a acesta: "Iată-mă!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν, Ἁβραὰμ, Ἁβραάμ· ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ኢትደይ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘትገብር ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወኢምንተኒ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ አእመርኩ ፡ ከመ
                  ፡ ትፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አንተ ፡ ወኢምሕከ ፡ ለወልድከ ፡ ዘታፈቅር ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.translation: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the child, neither do anything to him, for now I know that thou fearest God, and for my sake thou hast not spared thy beloved son.

translations.lxx: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the child, neither do anything to him, for now I know that thou fearest God, and for my sake thou hast not spared thy beloved son.
translations.kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
translations.ron: Iar îngerul a zis: "Să nu-ţi ridici mâna asupra copilului, nici să-i faci vreun rău, căci acum cunosc că te temi de Dumnezeu şi pentru mine n-ai cruţat nici pe singurul fiu al tău".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, μὴ ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τὸ παιδάριον, μηδὲ ποιήσῃς αὐτῷ μηδέν· νῦν γὰρ ἔγνων, ὅτι φοβῇ σὺ τὸν Θεόν· καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσω τοῦ υἱοῦ σου τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ διʼ ἐμέ.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ነጸረ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይሬኢ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ወእኁዝ ፡ በአቅርንቲሁ ፡ በዕፀ ፡ ሳቤቅ ፡ ወሖረ ፡
                  አብርሃም ፡ ወነሥኦ ፡ ወሦዖ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወልዱ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam lifted up his eyes and beheld, and lo! a ram caught by his horns in a plant of Sabec; and Abraam went and took the ram, and offered him up for a whole-burnt-offering in the place of Isaac his son.

translations.lxx: And Abraam lifted up his eyes and beheld, and lo! a ram caught by his horns in a plant of Sabec; and Abraam went and took the ram, and offered him up for a whole-burnt-offering in the place of Isaac his son.
translations.kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
translations.ron: Şi ridicându-şi Avraam ochii, a privit, şi iată la spate un berbec încurcat cu coarnele într-un tufiş. Şi ducându-se, Avraam a luat berbecul şi l-a adus jertfă în locul lui Isaac, fiul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναβλέψας Ἁβραὰμ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ εἶδε, καὶ ἰδοὺ κριὸς εἷς κατεχόμενος ἐν φυτῷ Σαβὲκ τῶν κεράτων. Καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ἁβραὰμ, καὶ ἔλαβε τὸν κριὸν, καὶ ἁνήνεγκεν αὐτὸν εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν ἀντὶ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወሰመዮ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ርእየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይበሉ ፡ ዮም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ ርእየ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam called the name of that place, The Lord hath seen; that they might say to-day, In the mount the Lord was seen.

translations.lxx: And Abraam called the name of that place, The Lord hath seen; that they might say to-day, In the mount the Lord was seen.
translations.kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
translations.ron: Avraam a numit locul acela Iahve-ire, adică, Dumnezeu poartă de grijă şi de aceea se zice astăzi: "În munte Domnul Se arată".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἁβραὰμ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου, Κύριος εἶδεν· ἵνα εἴπωσιν σήμερον, ἐν τῷ ὄρει Κύριος ὤφθη.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ደግመ ፡ እምሰማይ ።
verses.translation: And an angel of the Lord called Abraam the second time out of heaven,

translations.lxx: And an angel of the Lord called Abraam the second time out of heaven,
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
translations.ron: Şi a strigat a doua oară îngerul Domnului din cer către Avraam şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἄγγελος Κυρίου τὸν Ἁβραὰμ δεύτερον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ መሐልኩ ፡ በርእስየ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ገበርኮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወኢምሕካሁ ፡ ለወልድከ ፡
                  ዘታፈቅር ፡ እምኔየ ፤
verses.translation: saying, I have sworn by myself, says the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and on my account hast not spared thy beloved son,

translations.lxx: saying, I have sworn by myself, says the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and on my account hast not spared thy beloved son,
translations.kjv: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
translations.ron: "Juratu-M-am pe Mine însumi, zice Domnul, că de vreme ce ai făcut aceasta şi n-ai cruţat nici pe singurul tău fiu, pentru Mine,
translations.grk: λέγων, Κατʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ὤμοσα, λέγει Κύριος, οὗ εἵνεκεν ἐποίησας τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσω τοῦ υἱοῦ σου τοῦ ἀγαπτοῦ διʼ ἐμὲ,

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ባርኮ ፡ እባርከከ ፡ ወአብዝኆ ፡ ኣስተባዝኀከ ፡ ለዘርእከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡
                  ድንጋገ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወይትዋረሱ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ፀር ።
verses.translation: surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand which is by the shore of the sea, and thy seed shall inherit the cities of their enemies.

translations.lxx: surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand which is by the shore of the sea, and thy seed shall inherit the cities of their enemies.
translations.kjv: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
translations.ron: De aceea te voi binecuvânta cu binecuvântarea Mea şi voi înmulţi foarte neamul tău, ca să fie ca stelele cerului şi ca nisipul de pe ţărmul mării şi va stăpâni neamul tău cetăţile duşmanilor săi;
translations.grk: Ἦ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε, καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα σου, ὡς τοὺς ἀστέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ὡς τὴν ἄμμον τὴν παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης· καὶ κληρονομήσει τὸ σπέρμα σου τὰς πόλεις τῶν ὑπεναντίων.

verses.geez: ወይትባረኩ ፡ በዘርእከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ ቃልየ ።
verses.translation: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thou hast hearkened to my voice.

translations.lxx: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thou hast hearkened to my voice.
translations.kjv: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
translations.ron: Şi se vor binecuvânta prin neamul tău toate popoarele pământului, pentru că ai ascultat glasul Meu".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς, ἀνθʼ ὧν ὑπήκουσας τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς.

verses.geez: ወገብአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቁ ፡ ወተንሥኡ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዐዘቅተ ፡ መሐላ ።
verses.translation: And Abraam returned to his servants, and they arose and went together to the well of the oath; and Abraam dwelt at the well of the oath.

translations.lxx: And Abraam returned to his servants, and they arose and went together to the well of the oath; and Abraam dwelt at the well of the oath.
translations.kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
translations.ron: Întorcându-se apoi Avraam la slugile sale, s-au sculat împreună şi s-au dus la Beer-Şeba şi a locuit Avraam acolo în Beer-Şeba.
translations.grk: Ἀπεστράφη δὲ Ἁβραὰμ πρὸς τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐπορεύθησαν ἅμα ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου. Καὶ κατῴκησεν Ἁβραὰμ ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ዜነውዎ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ወለደት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሜልካ ፡ ለናኮር ፡
                  ለእኁከ ፤
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Abraam, saying, Behold, Melcha herself too has born sons to Nachor thy brother,

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after these things, that it was reported to Abraam, saying, Behold, Melcha herself too has born sons to Nachor thy brother,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
translations.ron: Iar după ce s-au petrecut acestea, i s-a vestit lui Avraam, spunându-i-se: "Iată Milca a născut şi ea fii lui Nahor, fratele tău:
translations.grk: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα, καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ Ἁβραὰμ, λέγοντες, ἰδοὺ τέτοκε Μελχὰ καὶ αὐτὴ υἱοὺς τῷ Ναχὼρ τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου,

verses.geez: ሆካስ ፡ በኵራ ፡ ወ[በ]ዋክሴን ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ወቃማኤል ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ለሶርያ ፤
verses.translation: Uz the first-born, and Baux his brother, and Camuel the father of the Syrians, and Chazad, and

translations.lxx: Uz the first-born, and Baux his brother, and Camuel the father of the Syrians, and Chazad, and
translations.kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
translations.ron: Pe Uţ, întâiul său născut, pe Buz, fratele acestuia şi pe Chemuel, tatăl lui Aram;
translations.grk: τὸν Οὒζ πρωτότοκον, καὶ τὸν Βαὺξ ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸν Καμουὴλ πατέρα Σύρων,

verses.geez: ወከዛት ፡ ወኢዛራው ፡ ወፈልዘር ፡ ወዮፋት ፡ ወባ[ቱ]ኤል ፤
verses.translation: Azav and Phaldes, and Jeldaph, and Bathuel, and Bathuel begot Rebecca;

translations.lxx: Azav and Phaldes, and Jeldaph, and Bathuel, and Bathuel begot Rebecca;
translations.kjv: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
translations.ron: Pe Chesed, pe Hazo, pe Pildaş, pe Idlaf şi pe Batuel.
translations.grk: καὶ τὸν Χαζὰδ, καὶ Ἀζαῦ, καὶ τὸν Φαλδὲς, καὶ τὸν Ἰελδὰφ, καὶ τὸν Βαθουήλ.

verses.geez: ዘወለዳ ፡ ለርብቃ ፡ እሉ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ እለ ፡ ወለደት ፡ ሜልካ ፡ ለናኮር ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለአብርሃም ።
verses.translation: these are eight sons, which Melcha bore to Nachor the brother of Abraam.

translations.lxx: these are eight sons, which Melcha bore to Nachor the brother of Abraam.
translations.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
translations.ron: Iar lui Batuel i s-a născut Rebeca". Pe aceşti opt fii i-a născut Milca lui Nahor, fratele lui Avraam.
translations.grk: Βαθουὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησε τὴν Ῥεβέκκαν. ὀκτὼ οὗτοι υἱοὶ, οὓς ἔτεκε Μελχὰ τῷ Ναχὼρ τῷ ἀδελφῷ Ἁβραάμ.

verses.geez: ወዕቀብቱ ፡ ርሔማ ፡ ወለደቶ ፡ ለቃዐት ፡ ወለ[ገአም] ፡ ወጦኮ ፡ ወሞካ ።
verses.translation: And his concubine whose name was Rheuma, she also bore Tabec, and Taam, and Tochos, and Mocha.

translations.lxx: And his concubine whose name was Rheuma, she also bore Tabec, and Taam, and Tochos, and Mocha.
translations.kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
translations.ron: Iar o ţiitoare a lui, anume Reuma, i-a născut şi ea pe Tebah, pe Gaham, pe Tahaş şi pe Maaca.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ, ᾗ ὄνομα Ῥεύμα, ἔτεκε καὶ αὐτὴ τὸν Ταβὲκ, καὶ τὸν Ταὰμ, καὶ τὸν Τοχός, καὶ τὸν Μοχά.

note: The binding of Isaac. In Genesis, God tests Abraham. In Jubilees 17, Mastema proposes the test. The same event, two radically different theologies of divine testing.
